prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry, and the channels you need (SEO, paid media, social, content, email, creative, CRO, analytics, etc.).

Before I recommend a few agencies, tell me briefly:
- Your primary objective (lead gen, e‑commerce sales, brand awareness, app installs, etc.)
- B2B or B2C?
- Monthly budget (or project budget)
- Any industry focus or channel priorities
- Timeline and whether you already have internal marketing resources

If you want to decide on your own, here’s a quick guide to choosing an agency:

What to evaluate
- Relevant experience: case studies for your industry and channel.
- Measurable results: ROI, CPA, LTV improvements — not just traffic.
- Reporting & analytics: transparent dashboards and monthly reviews.
- Team fit & communication: who will run your account, cadence, tools.
- Technical skills: tag management, tracking, creative production where needed.
- References: speak to 2–3 current or past clients.

Red flags
- Vague promises (e.g., “we’ll grow traffic 10x” with no plan)
- No clear KPIs or reporting
- Extremely low prices with long lock-in contracts
- No references or case studies

Typical cost ranges (very general)
- Freelancers / specialists: $1k–5k/month
- Small agencies / local: $3k–15k/month
- Mid-market agencies: $15k–50k/month
- Enterprise/full-service: $50k+/month

How I can help now
- If you give the short answers above I’ll shortlist 3 San Francisco agencies tailored to your needs (with why each fits).
- Or I can pull a list of top-rated local agencies and what they specialize in. Which would you prefer?
